name: openvizpilot
description: Tableau Dashboard Extension mit LLM-Chat über eine LiteLLM-Middleware

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,ext -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/server" "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/extension"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n server,ext -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/server" "npm run dev:mock -w @openvizpilot/extension"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n llm,server,ext -c yellow,blue,magenta "node packages/server/scripts/mock-litellm.mjs" "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/server" "npm run dev:mock -w @openvizpilot/extension"
scripts.dev:demo:sso: concurrently -n oidc,llm,server,ext -c green,yellow,blue,magenta "npm run mock-oidc -w @openvizpilot/ee" "node packages/server/scripts/mock-litellm.mjs" "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/server" "npm run dev:mock -w @openvizpilot/extension"
scripts.dev:claude: concurrently -n claude,server,ext -c yellow,blue,magenta "node packages/server/scripts/claude-code-llm.mjs" "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/server" "npm run dev -w @openvizpilot/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @openvizpilot/shared && npm run build -w @openvizpilot/server && npm run build -w @openvizpilot/extension
